fact: Africa50 led a USD 28 million Series C equity round in Poa! Internet, a Kenyan broadband provider, with Novastar Ventures, Seedstars Africa Ventures and Taru Capital also taking part; Africa50's own ticket is not disclosed, and the document dates the deal to 2022 (published 2022-01-01).

Novastar Ventures made its third follow-on equity investment in Kenyan broadband provider poa! internet as part of a USD 28 million Series C round led by Africa50; Novastar's own ticket is not stated (about USD 3 million is only an estimate), and the document is dated 2022 (published 2022-01-01).

Novastar Ventures and AfricInvest (through the Cathay AfricInvest Innovation Fund) co-led a USD 10 million Series A equity round in Turaco, an embedded-insurance company headquartered in Kenya that also operates in Uganda, Tanzania, Ghana and Nigeria; no amount is split out for Kenya, and the document is dated 2022 (published 2022-01-01).

Partech Africa led a USD 23 million Series A round in Kyosk, a Kenya-based B2B e-commerce platform serving small retailers, with Quona Capital also investing; the document gives June 2022 for the round.

4DX Ventures led a USD 2 million seed round in Sokowatch (later Wasoko), a Kenya-based B2B e-commerce platform, with Village Global, Lynett Capital, Golden Palm Investments and Outlierz Ventures as co-investors; the document is dated 2018 (published 2018-01-01).

TLcom Capital committed up to US$4 million to Twiga Foods, a Kenya-based mobile food-distribution platform, as co-lead of a US$10 million Series B alongside IFC and DOB Equity; the document does not give TLcom's home country, and dates the deal 2018.

A consortium led by France Telecom (France) won the bid in late 2007 and paid US$390 million for 51 percent of Telkom Kenya, per IFC's 2013 PPP story, which also counts over US$404 million invested by the private sector in the transaction.

Creadev (a French private equity firm) and Juven provided Twiga Foods, a Nairobi-based produce platform, a US$35 million convertible debt round in December 2023, used to clear overdue supplier debts, per TechCabal.
Twiga Foods said it committed approximately US$10 million in May 2022 to launch Twiga Fresh, a commercial farming subsidiary in Kenya (1,606 acres in Taita Taveta), per TechCabal.

TechCabal reports that Kenyan conversational-commerce startup Chpter raised a USD 1.2 million pre-seed round in 2024 from investors including Ventures Platform, Future Africa, Launch Africa and Techstars; the investors' home countries are not stated.

The US Overseas Private Investment Corporation (OPIC) committed a US$4.1 million commercial loan to Mawingu Networks Limited, a Kenyan rural broadband company, co-committed with Microsoft Global Finance; the document gives the commitment year as 2016.
system: Mawingu Networks Rural Internet Expansion Kenya (OPIC loan)

fact: EBRD (a multilateral development bank) signed a senior loan to Axian Telecom group that includes a local-currency facility of up to EUR 20 million equivalent in Kenyan shillings, the only amount the document names for Kenya, to support fibre modernisation there, per White & Case.

IFC (a development finance institution) committed US$25 million of a US$30 million multi-currency debt package to Atlas Tower Kenya Limited, a private mobile tower company, to build new towers and green power; the commitment is dated 2026-06-18 in the IATI record.
